name: TinyCloud Chat
description: TinyCloud Chat — a private AI chatbot. Conversations are stored in your TinyCloud space.

permissions.description: Read and write chat threads and messages.
Store chat threads and messages in your space's SQL database.
Store meeting metadata synced from connected sources (e.g. Fireflies) in your space's SQL database.
Store transcript content synced from connected sources in your space.
Read and write the wrapped encryption key for the stored Fireflies API key.

API_KEY.description: Store your Fireflies API key, encrypted, in your secrets space.
